base_eligibility.dynasty_evidence: Explicit dynasty keeperType OR the already validated missing-keeperType historical proxy; observed keeper/redraft/other formats rejected.

contamination_screen.identity_namespace_rule: MFL custom player IDs are league-scoped and must never be treated as globally unique. Custom identities may be matched only with league-scoped metadata plus unambiguous normalized name+position+NFL draft class.
contamination_screen.league_rule: A league with any positive contamination evidence is excluded from every V4 primary/source-sufficiency scope. Diagnostic unknown identities are reported but are not silently converted into same-year identities.
positive_contamination_evidence: Any resolved standard-player identity in the audited draft scope whose NFL draft class is earlier than the league draft year.
Any resolved standard-player identity in the audited draft scope whose NFL draft class is later than the league draft year.
Any league-scoped custom-player identity that unambiguously maps to an earlier or later NFL draft class.
Any league-scoped custom-player metadata explicitly identifying a Devy player/placeholder.

decision_rule.next_if_fail: Close the MFL historical-draft source-recovery path unless a materially different pre-outcome source design is preregistered.
decision_rule.next_if_pass: Freeze a new V4 clean source catalog and full V4 preregistration, then independently rerun harvest/identity gates before any outcomes.

depth_scopes.idp_r6_sensitivity: clean, nonmock IDP eligible leagues complete through Round 6; sensitivity only
depth_scopes.primary_r1_r4: clean, nonmock eligible leagues complete through Round 4
depth_scopes.primary_r5: clean, nonmock, non-IDP eligible leagues complete through Round 5
depth_scopes.primary_r6: clean, nonmock, non-IDP eligible leagues complete through Round 6

forbidden_before_recovery_decision: current KTC or other current market values as fit targets
lowering or rewriting inherited source-sufficiency thresholds
adding search terms/caps after observing recovery counts
manual league inclusion to cross a gate
objective: Determine whether a contamination-aware, reproducibly expanded historical MFL search can produce a sufficient 2018-2023 cohort of genuine 12-team SF/2QB rookie drafts without reading player outcomes or changing the inherited V3 source-sufficiency bars.

search_universe.existing_clean_seed: The positively uncontaminated V3 catalog subset may be carried forward only as source evidence, with V3's stop preserved. It is not a V4 frozen catalog until a later catalog freeze.
search_universe.new_candidate_priority: Known V3 frozen-catalog league IDs remain auditable seeds; previously unseen IDs from the expanded bounded union are probed next in deterministic order.
search_universe.ordering: Deterministic SHA-256 ordering by year, search term, and league id.

year_balance.r6_weighting: equal year total with pooled hierarchical/smoothed exact-slot estimator
